title: Responder stopped: ValueError
detail: ValueError: diagnosis cites unobserved metric keys: db.pool_busy_ratio increases from ~0.8 pre-incident to ~0.99 at onset and remains high, db.qps multiplies by approximately 4x after incident onset, problem persists over several subsequent windows, svc.gateway.error_rate rises from 0.0 to >1.0 post-incident, svc.gateway.p99_ms jumps from ~100-190ms pre-incident to >2490ms, svc.orders.error_rate increases from 0.0 to as high as 0.98+ post-incident, svc.orders.p99_ms, svc.payments.p99_ms, db.quer
